name: EqualLearn Single Lumi Evaluation Fix
behavior: Remove Explore Evaluation Mode from normal login screen.
Automatically hide the regular 3D Lumi companion after a dedicated read-only demo account is verified.
Keep the Lumi Guided Evaluation toolbar as the only visible Lumi UI during demo sessions.
Restore the regular Lumi companion after sign-out or when a non-demo account is detected.
Prevent the Lumi widget from re-showing itself on resize while evaluation mode is active.
